result.detail:
VeriTriage [run:run-0001] ran once over all three logs combined and returned unknown_failure at 30% confidence. The knowledge document recommends a per-log session as well, because a combined input can hide a class. Running veritriage.investigate on each log separately, plus same-seed reruns to exclude flakiness, would strengthen the bucketing.

All three testbenches use the same top module name, tb_uart_repro. Each runs alone with the RTL, and simulator.run takes its top from the first file's entry, so a shared name keeps every run valid.

Sampling points are offset 2 ns from bit centres to avoid clock-edge races. A watchdog at 100 us forces a failed verdict if a frame never starts.

The repro gate (simulator.run expect=fail) is run by the platform and has not run yet.
